about: Trader Shield page prose: what it can do today, what it cannot yet, and what is coming. The page (trader.html) loads this file and renders it as given; 'N attacks tested' and the tested-with sentence come from the served attack table, never from here.
can: Keep your agent out of your wallets

MetaMask, Phantom, Coinbase Wallet, Rabby, Trust Wallet, OKX Wallet, Keplr and Solflare in Chrome, Brave, Edge, Opera, Vivaldi and Arc; MetaMask, Phantom, Keplr and Solflare in Firefox; Exodus and Electrum on the desktop; the Solana CLI key file — through file tools, the terminal, find, one-line scripts, copies and archives
Recognise real seed phrases
12 to 24 words, checked with the phrase's own checksum, so ordinary text doesn't trigger it — even written into a web address
Stop a seed phrase or wallet key leaving
however it goes: curl, wget or nc, a web address the agent opens, or a script that posts it — in block mode
Recognise your own raw private key
list your public addresses in Settings and a bare 64-character key that opens one is caught; transaction hashes are left alone
Spot a labelled private key or a Solana key
PRIVATE_KEY=, pk:, "privateKey": and similar, and any real Solana key; flagged, because your own trading config may hold one, and blocked when sent
Keep exchange API keys with their exchange
a Binance, OKX, Bybit, Coinbase Exchange or KuCoin key header sent anywhere but that exchange is blocked
Catch the approval a drainer needs
an approval to a wallet the verified threat graph lists as a drainer is blocked; any unlimited approval is flagged so you see it
Guard your other secrets
.env files, SSH keys, key files and the macOS keychain (its file and the security tool), through file tools and the terminal
Keep secrets out of Blackbox's logs
phrases and keys are scrubbed before anything is recorded
Explain every event
what the agent reached for, why it matters, and what led to it
cannot: Bitcoin Core and others are coming
wallets are recognised as installed from the Chrome Web Store; from Edge Add-ons only MetaMask is, so far
Kraken and Bitget use header names many other services share, so their keys are not matched yet
Trader Shield guards what your AI agent does, not other programs
Block links or addresses on their own
known scam sites and wallets are flagged; only an approval to a known drainer is blocked
Read a path a script builds piece by piece
quoted paths and the usual home-folder joins are read; a path assembled character by character is not
